audit.whatIsWrong: Two kit errors repeated across the page. (1) 'Her W shield' appears six times — Poppy's W is Steadfast Presence (armour/MR, move speed, stops dashes); it grants no shield. The shield is her passive, Iron Ambassador, and only after she picks the buckler back up. (2) wants.foe[1] and whys[5] describe 'her Q ground-slam knockup' — Hammer Shock has no knockup at all; it creates a zone that slows and then explodes.
audit.why: Both errors change how a player fights her. A permanent W shield reads as always-available burst absorption, when in reality it is a conditional passive she has to walk over to collect. And waiting for a Q knockup that does not exist means mis-timing the one CC chain she actually has: Heroic Charge into a wall, then the slow zone so you cannot walk out.
audit.corrected: Iron Ambassador named as the buckler pickup shield in whys[0], whys[2], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0]; Hammer Shock's slow zone replaces the invented knockup in whys[5] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart said Skill at Levels 4-5 and Level 6 and Heimerdinger at first item, while the page's own whys say 'your spike holds' at 4-5, 'her window' at 6 and 'she owns the pick threat' at first item.
audit.why: Packet chart is [Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Poppy, Poppy, Skill] over a 51.08% lane, and every why already agrees with it.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 -> Heimerdinger, 4 -> Poppy, 5 -> Poppy, 6 -> Skill in both layers, ratings matched, phase whys for those four rewritten from the generic template to the actual reason.

audit.why: Four spikes, right shape: your 2-3 zone, your 4-5 peak, her Level 6 Keeper's Verdict, her first-item wall-stun pick pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Keeper's Verdict is a channel you can cancel, and no Poppy cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Keeper's Verdict is flagged channel — interruptible by any CC — on a 140s cooldown at rank 1, so your grenade stun is a hard counter to the ability the page treats as unanswerable. Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10s at 475 range and is her only way onto you (flagged missing interaction).
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns gives Heroic Charge 14s and Keeper's Verdict 140s with the cancel stated; dontsFull[1].d and dosFull[2].d carry the same facts where a player will actually read them.

notes: Third fabrication class in this slice: 'her W shield' (six occurrences) — Poppy's W is Steadfast Presence and grants no shield; the shield is the Iron Ambassador buckler pickup. Also an invented 'Q ground-slam knockup' that Hammer Shock does not have. Corrected everywhere except 'early', 'mid' and 'late', which carry 'her W shield' inside long paragraphs I could not rewrite inside the length band without losing other real content — those three still need a pass. Separately: tldr says 'mind her W on dives', but Steadfast Presence stops DASHES and Heimerdinger has none, so that line is advice about a non-interaction; I left it rather than guess at a replacement of matching length. Not asserted (kit is silent): whether your grenade stun can cancel Keeper's Verdict after the untargetable frames begin, and whether Heroic Charge can pin you against your own turret.
